crossRefs.note: When I consider your heavens, the work of your fingers, the moon and the stars, which you have ordained;
Praise him, sun and moon! Praise him, all you shining stars!
Yahweh brought him outside, and said, “Look now toward the sky, and count the stars, if you are able to count them.” He…
Lift up your eyes on high, and see who has created these, who brings out their army by number. He calls them all by…

translations.web: He counts the number of the stars. He calls them all by their names.
translations.bsb: He determines the number of the stars; He calls them each by name.
translations.kjv: He telleth the number of the stars; he calleth them all by their names.
translations.asv: He counteth the number of the stars; He calleth them all by their names.
